subject: Exec availability consolidation + delegate plan for Xenith demo
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Katherine Mendez <katherine.mendez@xenith.io>, engaging@xenith.io
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec availability consolidation + delegate plan for Xenith demo

Katherine — following up from last week's discovery, Xenith is prioritized for our Q3 exec briefing. We want to lock a 30–45 minute window that ensures a VP or CIO-level attendee from your side and our CTO/Head of Solutions on ours.

Two options that work for our leadership:
- Tue 3 Jul, 09:00–09:45 PT (preferred)
- Wed 4 Jul, 13:00–13:45 PT (backup)

If your CTO can't join, we can proceed with a CIO/VP + brief CTO handoff to ensure technical questions are covered. Marcus (copied) will run the demo; Stephanie is the exec backup for any escalation. Can you confirm which window you prefer and who will be the executive sponsor on your side?

I've attached a short draft agenda and a runbook (internal) so you know who'll speak to each section. If you prefer a different cadence (20–30 min), say the word and we'll compress.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.com | (415) 555-0128
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Xenith_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 1p); demo-runbook.xlsx (XLSX, 8 rows)

From: Katherine Mendez <katherine.mendez@xenith.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: engaging@xenith.io, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 11:44:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Exec availability consolidation + delegate plan for Xenith demo

Thanks Logan — appreciate the options. Our CTO is traveling the week of Jul 3 and won't be available. Our VP of Platform, Elena Torres, can attend and will be the executive sponsor. She prefers afternoon PT if possible. Of your two options, Wed 4 Jul 13:00 PT is the only one that aligns with Elena's calendar.

A couple of asks before we lock:
- Can you share a high-level list of security artifacts (SOC2 and data retention) we can review ahead of time?
- We typically keep exec demos to 30 minutes with a 15-minute open Q&A — that format works for us.

If you can move the agenda to 30 + Q&A and confirm Marcus as the primary presenter, we'll mark the slot tentative and send a calendar hold.

—Katherine
Katherine Mendez
Sales Operations Lead | Xenith Solutions
katherine.mendez@xenith.io | +1 312-555-0187

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Katherine Mendez <katherine.mendez@xenith.io>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec availability consolidation + delegate plan for Xenith demo

Katherine — thanks for confirming. Wed 4 Jul 13:00 PT works for our team. We'll compress to a 30-minute walkthrough + 15 minutes of Q&A. I'll cover architecture and performance, and Logan will do a 3–4 minute exec-level framing at the top. Stephanie will be on standby to handle any escalation or procurement questions.

I've updated the attached agenda to a 30+15 cadence (see Xenith_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf) and included a brief two-slide security summary. For SOC2 evidence, Logan — can you drop the standard SOC2 excerpt and retention bullets into the shared Drive link so Katherine's team can review?

I'll put a tentative hold on our calendars and send the invite once we have a confirmed attendee list.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Katherine Mendez <katherine.mendez@xenith.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec availability consolidation + delegate plan for Xenith demo

Katherine — thanks. I've uploaded the short SOC2 excerpt and our retention summary to the Drive link below (public to Xenith domain only):
https://drive.redwood.com/sheets/demo-runbook

I'll create the calendar invite for Wed 4 Jul 13:00–13:45 PT but label it as 30 min + optional 15 min Q&A so everyone knows the expectation. Please add Elena Torres and any technical folks who should join the Q&A.

Tentative attendees from our side:
- Logan Wright (exec framing)
- Marcus Lin (demo)
- Stephanie Nguyen (exec backup / procurement)

If Elena has a specific topic she wants us to prioritize, send it over and we'll tailor the three demo slides accordingly.

Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

From: Katherine Mendez <katherine.mendez@xenith.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@xenith.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 14:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Exec availability consolidation + delegate plan for Xenith demo

Confirmed: Wed 4 Jul, 13:00–13:45 PT. Elena Torres (VP of Platform) will join for the first 30 minutes; she may drop for the Q&A but will try to stay. I've added our lead infra engineer, Diego Alvarez (diego.alvarez@xenith.io), to the invite for the technical Q&A.

Agenda items we care most about:
1) Latency / SLA behavior for bursty inference workloads
2) Data residency and retention specifics
3) Migration path from current inference infra to Redwood Dedicated

Thanks for the quick turnaround — calendar hold incoming from my side. If you can attach the final 3-slide exec summary to the invite that would be great.

Best,
Katherine

Attachments mentioned: Xenith_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf; demo-runbook.xlsx
